reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a step-by-step educational walkthrough for creating and monetizing a YouTube channel using a demonstration channel. References to bank details, identity or address information, AdSense, and eligibility are described as platform setup requirements, while earnings are qualified by watch-time, subscriber, and review conditions. the available video evidence does not describe a deceptive promise or required payment to the speaker.

citations.quote: in today's video I will explain you in simple way that how you can make your own channel
how you can make a YouTube channel and earn money from it
If you do verify then only your monetization will be enabled
you have to have a bank account you have to link it
4000 hours and subscribers 50 had which is 1 k

opening.argument: The promised income is directly linked to a chain of actions viewers are instructed to take: create a channel, verify a phone number, link a bank account, open AdSense, and submit personal details. The video presents these steps as the route to earning money, not merely as background information. That is a low-barrier cash-reward pitch conditioned on account creation and verification. The viewer is encouraged to believe that completing the setup will lead to monetization, while the practical burden is shifted onto the viewer through banking, identity, address, and contact disclosures.

And give your phone number where you will get an OTP
you need to fill this form carefully and the same address to be filled out now give them your Aadhar card name in your Aadhar card

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a tutorial does not answer the central linkage: the promised earnings are attached to the requested setup steps. The explanation repeatedly moves from creating an account to verification, monetization, AdSense, and payment-related details. A demonstration format can still solicit viewers to enter a monetization pathway, especially when the headline frames the outcome as earning money. The fact that the speaker does not request payment does not eliminate a scam risk based on data and account access.

citations.quote: How To Create A Youtube Channel And Earn Money
sign up for adsense
Google Adsense Pin

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted steps show ordinary platform onboarding, not a deceptive reward flow. The video expressly describes eligibility conditions and review rather than guaranteeing payment merely for supplying information. Its account and address instructions are part of AdSense setup, and no evidence shows that viewers must send money to the speaker or use an unauthorized service. The income claim is therefore conditional and tied to producing content and satisfying platform requirements.

citations.quote: As the criteria both gets completed it will automatically
it is easy to make a Youtube Channel And by doing such a nice thing, you can earn money
If you do verify then only your monetization will be enabled

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: an easy-sounding money outcome, account verification, bank linking, AdSense registration, and submission of identity and address information. The description also directs viewers to multiple external social and shopping links, including equipment links. In combination, this is more than neutral discussion of video creation: it normalizes handing over sensitive information as the price of pursuing an attractive income claim. The presentation gives viewers a concrete sequence to follow but does not establish that earnings will actually result, making the promise materially more persuasive than the safeguards.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats each signal in isolation. The relevant concern is their combination: income is foregrounded, while phone verification, banking, AdSense, address, and identity information are presented as necessary steps. A disclaimer is not required for the structure to be risky; the question is whether the viewer is steered into a sensitive verification flow by an attractive return claim. The external links further reinforce that this is an ecosystem of directed participation rather than detached education.

citations.quote: after verification if monetization option is shown
your channel will be redirect to adsense account
My gears:- Camera - https://amzn.to/2Qzppjm

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are not unexplained red flags. The video identifies the platform processes involved and shows the official-looking YouTube and AdSense screens, including terms and conditions and payment address details. It also states that monetization depends on watch-time and subscriber thresholds and review. Social and equipment links in the description do not show that viewers are promised money for clicking them or that sensitive information is diverted to the speaker.

Read and agree to your partner program terms
your channel will be redirect to adsense account

opening.argument: Although packaged as instruction, the video functions as promotion for a money-making pathway. It opens with the proposition that viewers can earn from a YouTube channel, then walks them through the exact participation funnel: account creation, verification, monetization, AdSense, and uploading. The speaker also asks viewers to subscribe and directs them to social profiles and gear links. The educational framing therefore makes the income opportunity appear accessible and routine, encouraging participation while offering no evidence that the promised earnings are typical or attainable for a new viewer.

citations.quote: how you can make a YouTube channel and earn money from it
Then click on creator studio
sign up for adsense
you can earn money on Youtube

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on the existence of instructions, but instructional detail can itself be the promotional mechanism. The sequence turns an appealing income claim into a checklist viewers are urged to complete, and the closing call to subscribe extends the speaker's audience. Showing screens does not prove that the opportunity is reliable; it makes the pathway look established while leaving the viewer to assume that completion leads to earnings.

citations.quote: if you are new to the channel then subscribe

Don't forget to like, comment share & subscribe

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The calls to subscribe and follow are ordinary channel engagement, not proof that viewers are being sold a fraudulent opportunity. The content teaches navigation and setup through a demonstration, while explicitly explaining that eligibility requires thresholds and review. The quoted income language does not establish guaranteed, immediate, or typical returns, and the cited actions are standard YouTube operations rather than participation in a private scheme.
